x: Secretary, and Sam Sherrington the Captain. The headquarters were removed from the " Kings Arms " to the " William IV." on the Embankment; our training runs being from Grosvenor Road to Albert Bridge or round Battersea Park railings, over the Albert and Chelsea Bridges, 3½ miles approximately.
In 1898, Sam Sherrington, the Club Captain, became the second winner of the trophy and by 1920 had run up two more victories, thus entitling him to retain the cup as his own.
